title: Post-evidence GLH saving fixed
details: The post-evidence 'Did you learn anything?' flow now saves automatically to GLH when the active course is an NVQ
The same flow continues to save to OTJ for Standards and apprenticeship courses
NVQ GLH entries keep the learner's reflection, duration, date and evidence context and refresh the GLH progress arch immediately
Save GLH, Save guided learning and equivalent save buttons are now recognised by the post-evidence learning flow
The camera, evidence saving, Section E navigation, AC mapping and the rest of Evia are unchanged
summary: Evia v153 fixes automatic post-evidence GLH saving for NVQ learners.
